_comment: Seed biome lexicon for shattered_realms. The biome_layout section maps (row, col) grid blocks to biome IDs and is used by the runner as the authoritative source for biome hint derivation (robust against background_image edits).

mountain_pass.palette: storm grey, slate, rust red, bruised violet
silhouettes: distant silhouette of a stone watchtower perched on a cliff
a mountain goat on a narrow ledge far above
the skeletal remains of a fallen traveler half-buried in scree
a lone raven circling in the cold wind
landmarks: a crumbling stone bridge spanning a chasm
weather-carved rocks shaped like ancient faces
a frost-rimed cairn marking a forgotten grave

blighted_crossing.palette: sickly yellow-green, peat brown, ash grey
silhouettes: twisted figures shuffling in the middle distance
a gnarled tree with eye-like knots in its bark
a crow with too many feathers perched on a rotten post
landmarks: a blackened shrine overgrown with pulsing fungus
a half-sunken wagon bleeding a dark, oily sap
cracked flagstones leaking pale mist

frozen_wastes.palette: glacial blue, silver white, charcoal shadow
silhouettes: the silhouette of a frost wraith drifting at the edge of sight
a frozen mammoth half-exposed in a wall of ice
auroras flickering behind distant jagged peaks
landmarks: shards of black obsidian jutting through the snow
a tattered banner frozen mid-flap on a buried spear
the hollowed ribs of some great beast encased in ice

silhouettes: distant silhouette of a lean wolf with sickly green eyes
a weathered druid in moss-stained robes at the edge of the clearing
a will-o-wisp drifting between the trunks
landmarks: a crumbling stone obelisk half-buried in roots
a rusted iron lantern hanging from a low branch
a ring of pale mushrooms around a sunken stone

obsidian_citadel.palette: volcanic black, ember orange, tarnished gold
silhouettes: a hooded figure on a high parapet silhouetted against a red sky
a carrion bird perched on a cracked gargoyle
the outline of an armoured sentinel at the far end of the hall
landmarks: a soot-stained brazier smouldering with unnatural flame
a towering obsidian statue of a crowned warlord
a chained iron gate scarred with claw marks

scorched_sands.palette: bleached bone white, copper red, dusk violet
silhouettes: a hunched figure wrapped in sun-bleached rags at the horizon
a vulture circling above a distant ruin
the outline of a giant scorpion cresting a dune
landmarks: the bleached bones of a massive serpent half-sunken in sand
a toppled sandstone obelisk carved with forgotten glyphs
a cracked well of blackened stone

millhaven.palette: warm lantern yellow, walnut brown, hearth red
silhouettes: a lantern-bearing villager hurrying down a side street
a cat watching from an upstairs window
a hooded stranger leaning against a shuttered stall
landmarks: a sagging wooden inn with a creaking sign
a cracked stone well with a rusted iron chain
a covered wagon with a broken wheel

sunken_swamp.palette: bog green, peat black, sulphur yellow
silhouettes: the eyes of something enormous just above the waterline
a lizardfolk scout wading between reeds
a swarm of dragonflies above a patch of still water
landmarks: a half-submerged stone altar wrapped in vines
a rotten wooden walkway sinking into the muck
the jawbone of a great crocodile bleaching on a mudbank

crystal_caves.palette: prismatic blue, violet, pale mineral white
silhouettes: a glimmering crystal spider picking its way across a stalactite
a robed figure holding a glowing shard in cupped hands
bats wheeling through a shaft of crystalline light
landmarks: a cluster of resonant crystals humming faintly
a frozen waterfall of translucent stone
an ancient rune carved into a column of quartz
